header.name: D1-G2R g2 (xTB-level autodE TS from SMILES, label-free model inputs)

use_with.note: deploy / d1_g2 defaults point at the deleted $G2 and fail; pass these

header.usable_rule: target and L .done and a finite X182_lf row and a token

labels.note: labels_lf.json holds the g2 metadata with every DFT key NaN; label values come from the label files above

header.geometry_note: ts.xyz / rel1.xyz / rel2.xyz / A_idx / formed_pairs_ts / n_f1 are in the g2 (autodE) atom order, not the DFT label order

tolerances.how: analysis/g2r/site_g2r/sitecustomize.py with G2R_TOL_PATCH=1 (jobs/g_g2r.slurm); every other tolerance unchanged (decision D-5)
